_note: 服務頁配圖場景。scene 為英文寫實攝影描述；一律不帶文字。1600x900 (16:9)。

ads.scene: a Hong Kong advertising strategist and a client reviewing printed media plans and a laptop on a meeting room table, city view through the window, morning light
ads.caption: 投放前先確認目標、預算與可接受成本，再決定平台與素材方向。

ads.scene: over-the-shoulder view of a marketer comparing Meta and Google advertising dashboards on two monitors in a dim Hong Kong office, blue screen glow
ads.caption: Meta 與 Google 的成效分開檢視，再判斷預算應往哪一邊移動。

ads.scene: close-up detail of hands arranging several printed advertising visuals side by side on a wooden desk for comparison, soft daylight
ads.caption: 素材以同一條件並排測試，才知道差異來自哪一個變數。

ai.scene: a Hong Kong business team in a glass meeting room mapping internal processes on sticky notes on a whiteboard while a consultant listens
ai.caption: 導入 AI 之前，先盤點哪些工序重複、哪些判斷不能自動化。

ai.scene: close-up detail of a knowledge worker searching an internal document system on a laptop, documents and a notebook beside it, warm desk lamp
ai.caption: 企業知識庫把散落的文件集中，讓同事用自然語言找得到答案。

ai.scene: a software engineer configuring an API integration on a workstation with two monitors showing system diagrams, Hong Kong office at night
ai.caption: AI 要真正落地，通常需要與現有 CRM、ERP 或內部系統接通。

ai-agency.scene: two Hong Kong business owners interviewing an agency representative across a meeting table, documents and laptops open, daylight office
ai-agency.caption: 評估 AI 供應商時，重點是對方能否說清楚範圍、交付物與驗收方式。

ai-agency.scene: close-up detail of a hand annotating a printed project scope document with a pen next to a laptop, neutral office lighting
ai-agency.caption: 報價單寫明的範圍與不包含項目，比總價更影響項目成敗。

automation.scene: a Hong Kong operations manager drawing a workflow diagram on a whiteboard while two colleagues point at steps, bright open office
automation.caption: 先畫出流程的每一步，才看得出哪一步最值得自動化。

automation.scene: close-up detail of hands scanning and entering paper invoices beside a laptop in a small Hong Kong accounting office, natural daylight
automation.caption: 重複的單據輸入與對帳，是最常見也最容易自動化的工序。

automation.scene: a customer service officer replying to enquiries on a desktop messaging interface in a modern Hong Kong office, soft screen light
automation.caption: 查詢自動分流與回覆紀錄，減少漏接與重複輸入。

consulting.scene: a consultant taking notes while a Hong Kong business owner explains operations in a quiet meeting room, notebook and coffee on the table
consulting.caption: 先了解實際運作與痛點，才判斷應該用系統、內容還是廣告。

consulting.scene: over-the-shoulder view of two people reviewing a phased project timeline on a large screen in a meeting room, Hong Kong skyline outside
consulting.caption: 分階段的路線圖，讓每一期都有可驗收的交付物。

consulting.scene: a technician inspecting network equipment and cabling in a small Hong Kong server room, cool lighting
consulting.caption: 現有系統與資料狀況，往往決定導入新方案的實際工作量。

education.scene: a Hong Kong secondary school classroom with a teacher setting up a tablet and display for a lesson, students seated, natural window light
education.caption: 教學工具要配合課堂實際流程，而不是相反。

education.scene: a school IT panel meeting with teachers and a vendor representative around a table with a laptop and printed quotation documents
education.caption: 採購與報價程序須依教育局指引辦理，文件要經得起審計。

education.scene: small group of Hong Kong teachers attending a hands-on digital tools training session with laptops in a school computer room
education.caption: 系統上線後的教師培訓，決定工具會否被真正使用。

healthcare.scene: a Hong Kong clinic reception with a staff member assisting a patient at the counter, appointment screen and queue visible, clean bright interior
healthcare.caption: 預約、登記與輪候是診所每日重複最多的前線工序。

healthcare.scene: close-up detail of a healthcare practitioner reviewing patient records on a tablet beside a stethoscope on a consultation desk
healthcare.caption: 電子病歷讓查閱與交接更快，同時要符合資料私隱要求。

healthcare.scene: a clinic assistant handling billing and medicine stock records at a back office desk with printed receipts and a computer, daylight
healthcare.caption: 收費、庫存與對帳整合後，可減少漏收與重複核對。

kol.scene: a Hong Kong marketing executive comparing social media creator profiles on a laptop and printed screenshots spread on a desk
kol.caption: 選 KOL 看受眾是否對上，而不只是看粉絲數字。

kol.scene: behind the scenes of a product review shoot at a Hong Kong cafe, camera operator filming a creator holding a skincare product, natural light
kol.caption: 拍攝現場的溝通效率，直接影響內容質素與交付時間。

kol.scene: two marketers reviewing campaign performance charts on a laptop and printed report in a modern office meeting area
kol.caption: 以優惠碼或專屬連結追蹤成效，並區分助攻與實際轉換。

production.scene: a photography studio in Hong Kong with lighting equipment and a backdrop being prepared for a product shoot, assistant adjusting a softbox
production.caption: 燈光與背景設定，決定成品是否達到品牌要求。

production.scene: over-the-shoulder view of a director watching playback on a monitor on set, crew and equipment blurred in the foreground
production.caption: 現場即時檢視畫面，避免拍攝完成後才發現問題。

production.scene: close-up detail of an editor colour grading footage on a calibrated monitor in a dim editing suite, control panel beside the keyboard
production.caption: 後期調色與剪輯，是把素材變成可用成品的最後一關。

seo.scene: a Hong Kong digital marketer mapping keyword groups on a whiteboard covered in sticky notes while a colleague reviews a spreadsheet
seo.caption: 先按搜尋意圖分組關鍵字，再決定每個頁面負責哪一組。

seo.scene: over-the-shoulder view of a specialist reviewing crawl and index reports in a search console interface on a widescreen monitor
seo.caption: 技術問題會令優質內容無法被收錄，必須先處理。

seo.scene: close-up detail of a hand writing a content outline in a notebook beside a laptop showing a search results page, warm desk light
seo.caption: 內容大綱以實際搜尋問題為本，而不是關鍵字堆砌。

social.scene: a Hong Kong social media manager building a monthly content calendar on a wall planner with printed photos and notes, bright studio office
social.caption: 內容排程要在月初定好，才不會臨時湊數。

social.scene: a creator filming a short vertical video with a phone on a tripod in a Hong Kong retail shop, shopkeeper in the background
social.caption: 本地化短片內容，通常比通用素材更能帶動互動。

social.scene: close-up detail of hands replying to direct messages and comments on a desktop dashboard in a modern office
social.caption: 私訊與留言的回覆速度，直接影響查詢能否變成生意。

system.scene: a Hong Kong operations team explaining their daily workflow around a table with printed forms and a laptop, daylight office
system.caption: 系統設計由實際流程出發，先弄清楚資料從哪裡來、往哪裡去。

system.scene: a manager reviewing an internal management dashboard on a desktop monitor in a Hong Kong office, printed reports on the desk
system.caption: 把散落的試算表整合成單一資料來源，減少重複輸入。

system.scene: a small software team in a short stand-up meeting in front of a screen showing a task board, Hong Kong office, natural light
system.caption: 分階段交付與驗收，讓每一期都有可檢查的成果。

video.scene: a corporate interview being filmed in a Hong Kong office, interviewer and subject seated with a camera and microphone in the foreground
video.caption: 企業訪談影片的關鍵，是讓受訪者自然說出重點。

video.scene: close-up detail of a product being lit for a television commercial shoot on a set with reflective panels and a turntable
video.caption: 產品特寫需要精準打光，才呈現得出材質與細節。

video.scene: an editor cutting a vertical short video on a laptop with a phone showing the preview, subtitles visible on the timeline
video.caption: 垂直比例與字幕排版，是社交平台版本的必備處理。

web.scene: a designer and a client reviewing a website layout on a large monitor in a Hong Kong studio, printed wireframes on the table
web.caption: 版面以訪客的閱讀次序設計，而不是以裝飾效果為先。

web.scene: close-up detail of hands testing a website on a smartphone beside a laptop showing the same page in a development environment
web.caption: 手機版本是多數訪客第一眼看到的畫面，必須先做好。

web.scene: a shop owner packing an online order while a laptop shows an e-commerce order list in a Hong Kong retail back office
web.caption: 結帳步驟與送貨流程，直接影響轉換與營運成本。

about.scene: a small Hong Kong digital agency team working together around a table with laptops and printed documents, modern office with city view
about.caption: ADWire 以精簡核心團隊配合按項目協作的模式運作。

about.scene: a client workshop in a Hong Kong meeting room with sticky notes on a glass wall and two people discussing a process diagram
about.caption: 項目由業務問題出發，先確認要解決什麼，再決定用什麼方案。

about.scene: close-up detail of a developer workstation with code and a system architecture diagram on screen, notebook and pen beside the keyboard
about.caption: 軟件開發與 AI 應用是我們現時的重心。

about.scene: view from a Hong Kong office window overlooking Kwai Chung and the harbour, desk and plant in the foreground, late afternoon light
about.caption: 辦公室位於葵芳，服務香港及大灣區企業。

contact.scene: a bright modern office reception area in Hong Kong with a meeting room visible behind glass, empty desk and plants, natural light
contact.caption: 歡迎先以電話、WhatsApp 或表格說明需求。
